reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering breakfast, deliberately hidden mask text, cookies, outdoor cooking, copper, coral, fishing tackle, crops, crab dishes, traps, and rings were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover preserved mystery punctuation, recipe names, ore and bar distinctions, fishing-bar mechanics, crop timing, item gender, and approved glossary terminology; both found no remaining objective issue.

CompleteBreakfast_Description.source: You'll feel ready to take on the world!
CompleteBreakfast_Description.translation: Te vei simți gata să cucerești lumea!

ConcernedApeMask_Name.preservationReason: The unrevealed mask name consists only of question marks, so preserving it exactly retains the intended mystery.

ConcernedApeMask_Description.preservationReason: The unrevealed mask description consists only of question marks, so preserving it exactly retains the intended mystery.

CookoutKit_Name.translation: Set de gătit în aer liber

CookoutKit_Description.source: Use this to create a cooking campfire, allowing you to cook on-the-go!
CookoutKit_Description.translation: Folosește-l pentru a face un foc de tabără pentru gătit, ca să poți găti oriunde!

CopperOre_Description.source: A common ore that can be smelted into bars.
CopperOre_Description.translation: Un minereu obișnuit care poate fi topit în lingouri.

CopperStone_Description.source: There's copper ore in this stone.
CopperStone_Description.translation: În această piatră se află minereu de cupru.

Coral_Name.preservationReason: Coral is the standard Romanian name and therefore remains identical to the English source.

Coral_Description.source: A colony of tiny creatures that clump together to form beautiful structures.
Coral_Description.translation: O colonie de creaturi minuscule care se adună pentru a forma structuri frumoase.

CorkBobber_Description.source: Slightly increases the size of your "fishing bar".

Corn_Description.source: One of the most popular grains. The sweet, fresh cobs are a summer favorite.
Corn_Description.translation: O cereală foarte populară. Știuleții dulci și proaspeți sunt preferați vara.

CornSeeds_Description.source: Plant these in the summer or fall. Takes 14 days to mature, and continues to produce after first harvest.
CornSeeds_Description.translation: Plantează-le vara sau toamna. Ajung la maturitate în 14 zile și continuă să producă după prima recoltă.

Crab_Name.preservationReason: Crab is the standard Romanian name of the crustacean and therefore remains identical to the English source.

Crab_Description.source: A marine crustacean with two powerful pincers.
Crab_Description.translation: Un crustaceu marin cu doi clești puternici.

CrabCakes_Description.source: Crab, bread crumbs, and egg formed into patties then fried to a golden brown.
CrabCakes_Description.translation: Carne de crab, pesmet și ou, modelate în chiftele și apoi prăjite până devin aurii.
